'''Sakresh''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|betting]] card game. At least one winning hand consisted of a perfect pyramid with clusters. The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Ulicx Vinaq]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Desh (Imperial)|Desh]] played a [[Standard week/Legends|weekly]] game of sakresh.
